action_items: Minor (out of scope of this ticket, but worth flagging): track.tsx lines 288-289 declare var path/pathInner with the canvas renderer, then lines 291-292 redeclare the SAME two vars with the default SVG renderer immediately below. Not a bug (JS var permits redeclaration and the second wins), but it makes the canvas-renderer branch dead code — the whole reason the canvas renderer was added (comment at 281-283, 'drift bug with leaflet-rotate') is silently defeated. Recommend removing lines 291-292.

rca_of_issue:
Original user report had three root causes, all fixed in this iteration:
1. DIST_GATE_M was 30.48m (100ft) — the popup silently returned '' for users off the mapped centerline. Raised to 500m and emptiness replaced with 'Distance unavailable'. Verified via distLabel test at (36.855, -111.55) which is ≈1100m off-line → returns 'Distance unavailable' as expected.
2. Popup content was frozen at popupopen time — refreshOpenPoiPopups now runs every ping; verified live: meta ticked 2.77 → 1.11 → 0.28 mi across three updatePos calls without closing the popup.
3. Reselecting same POI after moving gave stale distance — __baseTitle/__baseMeta captured once at marker creation and popupopen re-renders from bases with a fresh distLabel call using current currentUserLat/Lon, so reselect after move always computes fresh.
